lyrics:
paaduvaan moham...aaduvaan moham

paadithudangaan padangalillaa

aadithudangaan chuvadukalillaa  (paaduvaan)

 

neram kadannu sadassum niranju

nin swaram kelkkaathen kandamadanju

neelayavanika mandamuyarnnuu

nilayariyaathe njaan thengikkaranjuu

O....O...      (paaduvaan)

 

raavin dalangal pozhiyukayaayi

rangadeepangal poliyukayaayi

ennil nin thaalangal thengukayalle

ninnilen gaanam mayangukayalle

O....             (paaduvaan)
